GitHub repo and branch status Repo : hiwasham/AITransforms Default branch : main (production / deployed) Working branches (history): main — production; cumulative through Phase 3 apply flow (commit f28e1e3 add AI transformation review apply flow ) phase2-ui-branding — Phase 2 editorial visual redesign (merged) phase3-apply-flow — Phase 3 English /apply (merged) Phase 3 localized /apply (current pass): work is on main working tree, untracked. After commit + push it will land on a localized-apply branch and merge into main . 4. Phase summary Phase 1 — V1 ship Set up Next.js 16 App Router + TypeScript + Tailwind v4 + Vercel. Three locale routes ( / , /fa , /ar ) with static page generation. 12 section components per locale: Header, Hero, Problem, Framework, Services, AgentSpotlight, CaseStudies, Founder, ResourcesTeaser, CTA, Footer, LanguageSwitcher. Single content dictionary at src/content/site.ts keyed by locale. RTL plumbing via <div lang="..." dir="rtl"> wrappers in src/app/fa/layout.tsx and src/app/ar/layout.tsx . Build, lint, typecheck clean. Deployed to Vercel. Phase 2 — Editorial visual redesign Eight sub-passes (G–N) on phase2-ui-branding , merged to main : Pass G — Design tokens : replaced the 2-variable palette with 9 Phase 2 tokens ( bg-page , bg-surface , bg-inverse , text-ink , text-body , text-muted , border-rule , text-accent , text-accent-strong ). Registered Instrument Serif as --font-display . Pass H — Typography & rhythm : token swaps across every component, alternating section padding scale, dropped most border-b section separators in favor of whitespace. Pass I — Wordmark & Header : created reusable Wordmark.tsx with a clay SVG arrow glyph; made Header sticky; restyled LanguageSwitcher with vertical hairline separators and a clay underline on the active locale. Pass J — Hero : H1 in Instrument Serif at text-5xl/6xl/7xl ; primary CTA pill ( rounded-full bg-ink hover:bg-accent-strong ); secondary CTA clay-underlined; new "Business Brain → AI Systems" metaphor flourish. Pass K — Problem, Framework, Services : replaced card grids with editorial hairline-stacked rows. Problem uses large clay serif numerals; Framework becomes a horizontal flow with clay arrow separators at lg; Services becomes 4 stacked rows with title-left / body-right. Pass L — AgentSpotlight, CaseStudies, CTA : AgentSpotlight switched from full-bleed dark slab to contained rounded-2xl panel with a top chrome strip (clay vertical accent + eyebrow); CaseStudies stripped card chrome; CTA enlarged to a closing-moment with pill button and hairline frame. Pass M — Founder, Resources, content tidy : hoisted FOUNDER object ( displayName: "Hiwa" + per-locale role: "AI Transformation Architect & Founder, AITransforms" ); replaced fake article cards with 4 honest category teasers (Articles / Frameworks / Roadmaps / Technical Notes) + clay closing line. Pass N — Mobile polish, RTL QA, favicon, ship : section[id] { scroll-margin-top: 5rem } so anchor scrolls clear the sticky header; replaced default Next.js favicon.ico with a brand icon.svg (clay arrow on warm near-black). Plus a separate font pass (Pass T): Persian uses local IRANSans ( public/fonts/IRANSansWeb/ ); Arabic uses IBM Plex Sans Arabic via next/font/google as --font-arabic . English keeps Geist; mono stays Geist Mono. Fallback for both fa/ar is Noto Sans Arabic. Phase 3 — Apply flow Five sub-passes (O–S) on phase3-apply-flow : Pass O — Content scaffold + route : new src/content/apply.ts (English-only at first), new /apply route, 8 section component stubs in src/components/apply/ , 6 homepage CTA repointed to /apply (with translated labels). Pass P — ApplyHero + ApplyProblem + Diagnostic : ApplyHero gets full Instrument Serif treatment + hairline tagline; ApplyProblem becomes hairlined rows with short clay vertical accent bars; Diagnostic becomes a 3-col grid at lg with clay-strong Diagnostic NN labels. Pass Q — WhatWeReview + WhoThisIsFor + AfterApply : WhatWeReview = 2-col list with clay arrow markers, no hairlines; WhoThisIsFor = <dl> dictionary-entry layout with whitespace separation; AfterApply = 3-step horizontal flow with clay arrow separators at lg (mirrors home Framework). Pass R — ApplyForm : converted to "use client" component with controlled state, HTML5 validation (required Name/Email/Company/helpWith/Consent; maxLength={1000} on textareas; type="email" and type="url" ), and a mailto: submit handler that constructs a structured body. Visible fallback email line below submit button as Plan B. Pass S — Reassurance + final QA : polished Reassurance into a quiet closing trust note (hairline + em-dash bullets); verified all 8 sections, 4 CTA flows, and form behavior. Plus the localized apply work (current pass, untracked on main ): - Restructured apply.ts into locale-keyed { en, fa, ar } . - Created /fa/apply and /ar/apply routes with full Persian / Arabic translations. - Diagnostic prefix label localized per locale ( itemLabel ). - ApplyForm lazy initializer defaults the language radio to the page's own language; mailto body labels now read from f.*.label so submitters see their compose window in their own language. - Persian homepage primary CTAs → /fa/apply ; Arabic homepage primary CTAs → /ar/apply ; English homepage primary CTAs stay → /apply . 5. Typography setup Loaded fonts (all via next/font/google in src/app/layout.tsx , except IRANSans which is local): Font Source CSS variable Used for Geist next/font/google --font-geist-sans ( font-sans ) English body text (default) Geist Mono next/font/google --font-geist-mono ( font-mono ) Mono (unused on page surfaces) Instrument Serif next/font/google --font-instrument-serif ( font-display ) Hero H1s only (home + apply, en only) IBM Plex Sans Arabic next/font/google --font-arabic Arabic body ( :lang(ar) ) Noto Sans Arabic next/font/google --font-noto-arabic Fallback for fa + ar IRANSans Web (Regular/Medium/Bold) local — public/fonts/IRANSansWeb/ via @font-face in globals.css (no CSS variable; family name IRANSans ) Persian body ( :lang(fa) ) :lang(fa), :lang(ar) rules in globals.css also reset letter-spacing: normal because Tailwind tracking utilities break Arabic cursive joining. Persian/Arabic don't inherit Instrument Serif because the :lang() rule wins the cascade and overrides font-family back to IRANSans / IBM Plex Sans Arabic. 6. Domain setup Primary domain : v1.aitransforms.ir (Iranian TLD). Hosting : Vercel (static). DNS : v1.aitransforms.ir points at Vercel; configured in Vercel project settings. Default Vercel URL : ai-transforms.vercel.app currently returns 404 — production traffic uses the custom domain. The v1. subdomain prefix reserves room for future major-version domains (e.g. v2.aitransforms.ir ). 7. Form / apply behavior The /apply , /fa/apply , and /ar/apply forms all behave identically aside from language: Behavior Detail Component src/components/apply/ApplyForm.tsx — the only "use client" component in the project Submission target mailto:iranfluent.com@gmail.com Email subject AI Transformation Review Application (universal English, all locales) Email body Localized to the page's locale — labels in fa / ar / en match what the submitter saw Visible fallback "Or email us directly at iranfluent.com@gmail.com." with the email as a clickable mailto link State management Single useState<FormState> object; 10 fields total Validation HTML5 — required on Name / Email / Company / "What do you want AI to help with?" / Consent; type="email" and type="url" ; maxLength={1000} on the three textareas Default language radio First option of the locale (English on en, Persian on fa, Arabic on ar) Form fields Name; Email; Company or project; Website (optional); 3 textareas (help-with / existing / bottleneck); Interests (multi-checkbox: 4 service categories); Preferred language (radio: 3 options); Consent (required) No backend No API routes, no server actions, no database, no CMS, no auth. Form data only exits the user's machine when they send the prefilled email from their mail client. 8. Known limitations <html lang> and root dir are always lang="en" with no dir attribute at the root layout. Persian and Arabic routes get RTL via a nested <div lang="..." dir="rtl"> in src/app/fa/layout.tsx and src/app/ar/layout.tsx . Search engines and assistive tech would benefit from correct root-level attributes — requires per-locale root layouts. Mobile navigation hides anchor links at <sm breakpoint ( hidden sm:flex ). Phone visitors only see the wordmark + language switcher. No hamburger menu. Language switcher always links to homepages ( / , /fa , /ar ), not the equivalent apply route. A visitor on /fa/apply clicking "العربية" lands on /ar , not /ar/apply . Locale-aware path mapping is a future improvement. Translations are V1 quality — Persian and Arabic content was translated directly rather than reviewed by a native speaker. Acceptable for V1; flagged for native review. No submission tracking by design (no backend). The site can't observe whether a user actually sent the prefilled email. mailto: URL length — with Persian/Arabic content and three 1000-char textareas, the URL can exceed 20-30 KB. Most modern mail clients handle it; legacy Windows configurations may truncate. Visible fallback email line is the explicit Plan B. Diagnostic numerals stay Latin ( 01–05 ) in all locales for visual consistency with the home Problem section. Persian/Arabic readers see Latin digits in the Diagnostic prefix. mailto subject is universal English — recipient-friendly for inbox filtering, but submitters see English text in their mail composer subject line. No focus-visible rings on form inputs — relies on browser defaults. A consistent focus-ring policy is a future a11y polish item. public/fonts/ ships unused IRANSans weight directories (Light, UltraLight, Black, the (FaNum) variant tree, the original IRANSans.zip , the WebFonts.png preview). These aren't referenced by CSS but are publicly accessible at /fonts/... URLs. Cleanup is a small future task. No Open Graph / social meta tags — link previews on Slack/LinkedIn/iMessage use Next's default behavior. No sitemap.xml or robots.txt — light SEO items. AgentSpotlight is the only dark surface on every page. Intentional; no visual variety pattern beyond it currently. 9. Phase 4 backlog In rough priority order: Translation review — native-speaker review of all Persian and Arabic copy, especially the /apply flow and form labels. Locale-aware LanguageSwitcher — when on /fa/apply clicking another language should land on the equivalent apply route in that language, not the homepage. <html lang> and dir per locale at the root layout — requires either per-locale root layouts or a dynamic root layout. Improves SEO and a11y signaling. Mobile navigation — small hamburger menu or section anchor dropdown so phone visitors can navigate without scrolling through every section. Open Graph + social meta — per-locale og:title , og:description , og:image . The icon.svg could be the basis for a 1200×630 OG image. Sitemap.xml + robots.txt — light SEO. Submission tracking — privacy-friendly analytics event on the submit handler (Plausible, Vercel Analytics) to observe conversion. Real Resources content — the homepage Resources teaser still says "First writeups coming soon." Ship the actual first writeup. Diagnostic numerals localization — lift 01–05 into per-locale number fields so fa shows ۰۱–۰۵ and ar shows ٠١–٠٥ . mailto subject localization — per-locale subject would let submitters see a familiar string in their compose window. Trade-off: recipient-side filtering becomes locale-aware. Long mailto fallback — copy-to-clipboard button that generates the same body text, for edge cases where the prefilled compose window fails. Focus-visible rings — global focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-accent focus-visible:outline-offset-2 on interactive elements for clearer keyboard-only navigation. public/fonts/ cleanup — delete the unused IRANSans weight directories, the (FaNum) tree, the original .zip , and the WebFonts.png preview to slim the deployed artifact. Founder photo / signature — only if/when the founder is ready to add it; current restraint is intentional. AgentSpotlight pattern reuse — if a second contained dark moment is wanted elsewhere, the rounded-2xl bg-inverse text-white pattern is reusable. 10. How to run / build / deploy locally Prerequisites Node.js 20+ npm (project uses npm — no yarn / pnpm) Install git clone https://github.com/hiwasham/AITransforms.git cd AITransforms npm install Develop npm run dev # Open http://localhost:3000 # Routes: /, /fa, /ar, /apply, /fa/apply, /ar/apply Verify npm run build # Next.js static build (Turbopack) npm run lint # ESLint npx tsc --noEmit # TypeScript typecheck All three commands must pass cleanly before pushing. Deploy Production : push to main . Vercel auto-deploys to v1.aitransforms.ir . Preview : push any other branch. Vercel auto-generates a preview URL (also visible in GitHub PR checks). No environment variables required. No Vercel build overrides needed. The Next.js auto-detection on Vercel handles everything. Project structure src/ app/ layout.tsx Root layout, font loaders globals.css Tailwind v4 + design tokens + IRANSans @font-face icon.svg Brand favicon page.tsx Home (English) fa/ layout.tsx <div lang="fa" dir="rtl"> page.tsx Home (Persian) apply/ page.tsx /fa/apply ar/ layout.tsx <div lang="ar" dir="rtl"> page.tsx Home (Arabic) apply/ page.tsx /ar/apply apply/ page.tsx /apply (English) components/ Header.tsx Sticky header w/ wordmark + nav + language switcher Wordmark.tsx Reusable brand mark w/ clay arrow SVG Footer.tsx Wordmark + tagline + contact + copyright LanguageSwitcher.tsx EN | FA | AR with vertical hairlines + clay underline Hero.tsx, Problem.tsx, Framework.tsx, Services.tsx, AgentSpotlight.tsx, CaseStudies.tsx, Founder.tsx, ResourcesTeaser.tsx, CTA.tsx Arrow.tsx Reusable clay arrow glyph (sm / md / lg) apply/ ApplyHero.tsx, ApplyProblem.tsx, Diagnostic.tsx, WhatWeReview.tsx, WhoThisIsFor.tsx, AfterApply.tsx, ApplyForm.tsx (the only "use client" component), Reassurance.tsx content/ site.ts Homepage content + CTA constants, locale-keyed apply.ts /apply content, locale-keyed (en / fa / ar) public/ fonts/ IRANSans.zip Original archive (kept for reference) IRANSansWeb/ Extracted .woff2/.woff (used by @font-face) IRANSansWeb(FaNum)/ Persian-digit variant (unused; available for swap) WebFonts.png License/preview image (unused) docs/ AITransforms-V1-Build-Packet.md Phase 1 build specification PROJECT-HANDOFF.md This document Adding content Homepage copy → src/content/site.ts (locale-keyed: en , fa , ar ). Apply page copy → src/content/apply.ts (locale-keyed). Both files use as const so each locale's literal type aligns across the union. Adding or removing a field in one locale requires the same change in the other two. Adding a route Place a page.tsx under src/app/<route>/ . Static generation is automatic. For a localized route, place it under src/app/fa/<route>/ or src/app/ar/<route>/ — it inherits the parent layout's dir="rtl" and lang attributes.

docs.title: 7. Form / apply behavior

docs.text: <html lang> and root dir are always lang="en" with no dir attribute at the root layout. Persian and Arabic routes get RTL via a nested <div lang="..." dir="rtl"> in src/app/fa/layout.tsx and src/app/ar/layout.tsx . Search engines and assistive tech would benefit from correct root-level attributes — requires per-locale root layouts. Mobile navigation hides anchor links at <sm breakpoint ( hidden sm:flex ). Phone visitors only see the wordmark + language switcher. No hamburger menu. Language switcher always links to homepages ( / , /fa , /ar ), not the equivalent apply route. A visitor on /fa/apply clicking "العربية" lands on /ar , not /ar/apply . Locale-aware path mapping is a future improvement. Translations are V1 quality — Persian and Arabic content was translated directly rather than reviewed by a native speaker. Acceptable for V1; flagged for native review. No submission tracking by design (no backend). The site can't observe whether a user actually sent the prefilled email. mailto: URL length — with Persian/Arabic content and three 1000-char textareas, the URL can exceed 20-30 KB. Most modern mail clients handle it; legacy Windows configurations may truncate. Visible fallback email line is the explicit Plan B. Diagnostic numerals stay Latin ( 01–05 ) in all locales for visual consistency with the home Problem section. Persian/Arabic readers see Latin digits in the Diagnostic prefix. mailto subject is universal English — recipient-friendly for inbox filtering, but submitters see English text in their mail composer subject line. No focus-visible rings on form inputs — relies on browser defaults. A consistent focus-ring policy is a future a11y polish item. public/fonts/ ships unused IRANSans weight directories (Light, UltraLight, Black, the (FaNum) variant tree, the original IRANSans.zip , the WebFonts.png preview). These aren't referenced by CSS but are publicly accessible at /fonts/... URLs. Cleanup is a small future task. No Open Graph / social meta tags — link previews on Slack/LinkedIn/iMessage use Next's default behavior. No sitemap.xml or robots.txt — light SEO items. AgentSpotlight is the only dark surface on every page. Intentional; no visual variety pattern beyond it currently.
docs.title: 8. Known limitations

docs.text: In rough priority order: Translation review — native-speaker review of all Persian and Arabic copy, especially the /apply flow and form labels. Locale-aware LanguageSwitcher — when on /fa/apply clicking another language should land on the equivalent apply route in that language, not the homepage. <html lang> and dir per locale at the root layout — requires either per-locale root layouts or a dynamic root layout. Improves SEO and a11y signaling. Mobile navigation — small hamburger menu or section anchor dropdown so phone visitors can navigate without scrolling through every section. Open Graph + social meta — per-locale og:title , og:description , og:image . The icon.svg could be the basis for a 1200×630 OG image. Sitemap.xml + robots.txt — light SEO. Submission tracking — privacy-friendly analytics event on the submit handler (Plausible, Vercel Analytics) to observe conversion. Real Resources content — the homepage Resources teaser still says "First writeups coming soon." Ship the actual first writeup. Diagnostic numerals localization — lift 01–05 into per-locale number fields so fa shows ۰۱–۰۵ and ar shows ٠١–٠٥ . mailto subject localization — per-locale subject would let submitters see a familiar string in their compose window. Trade-off: recipient-side filtering becomes locale-aware. Long mailto fallback — copy-to-clipboard button that generates the same body text, for edge cases where the prefilled compose window fails. Focus-visible rings — global focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-accent focus-visible:outline-offset-2 on interactive elements for clearer keyboard-only navigation. public/fonts/ cleanup — delete the unused IRANSans weight directories, the (FaNum) tree, the original .zip , and the WebFonts.png preview to slim the deployed artifact. Founder photo / signature — only if/when the founder is ready to add it; current restraint is intentional. AgentSpotlight pattern reuse — if a second contained dark moment is wanted elsewhere, the rounded-2xl bg-inverse text-white pattern is reusable.

docs.text: Release Workflow This document defines how releases and deployments happen for AITransforms. Core rule All releases and production deployments must go through the gstack /ship workflow. Do not push directly to main to deploy, and do not deploy from local builds. main is the production branch — Vercel auto-deploys it to v1.aitransforms.ir . Every change reaches main through /ship , which runs the verify gate, updates version and changelog, and opens the PR. What /ship does /ship is the single entry point for shipping. In order, it: Runs the verify gate (build, lint, typecheck) and refuses to proceed if any fail. Bumps VERSION per semantic versioning. Moves the [Unreleased] notes in CHANGELOG.md into a new dated version entry. Squashes work-in-progress commits into clean, reviewable commits. Opens a pull request against main . Merging the PR to main triggers the Vercel production deploy. Other branches get automatic Vercel preview URLs (also surfaced in the PR checks). Verify gate These must all pass before anything ships. /ship runs them; you can run them locally first: npm run build # Next.js static build (Turbopack) npm run lint # ESLint npx tsc --noEmit # TypeScript typecheck Versioning Source of truth is the VERSION file at the repo root. Follow Semantic Versioning : MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH . PATCH — fixes and copy/content tweaks with no structural change. MINOR — new sections, routes, or features that are backward compatible. MAJOR — breaking restructures (reserved; the v1. domain prefix leaves room for a future v2 ). Record every shipped change under the matching version heading in CHANGELOG.md . Changelog discipline Add notes under ## [Unreleased] as you work. /ship promotes [Unreleased] to a dated, versioned section at release time. Keep entries grouped by Added / Changed / Fixed / Removed . Out of scope for /ship No environment variables or Vercel build overrides are required. The site is fully static with no backend, so there are no migrations, secrets, or post-deploy steps to coordinate.
